name: employee-inventory-management
description: Employee Inventory Management — root scripts for building and running both halves together.
comment: This file exists mainly so hosting providers detect a Node project at the
repository root. Without a package.json here, Render's build container has
no Node toolchain on PATH and the build dies with 'command not found'
(exit status 127) before it reaches frontend/ or backend/.
It also gives one command for the whole system, which is easier to get
right than a chain of cd's: the frontend must be built before the backend
starts, because the backend serves frontend/dist and only looks for it at

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend ci
scripts.start: npm --prefix backend run setup && npm --prefix backend start
